name: decision
description: Declarative decision logic for AQL: express business rules as data — a condition, a compound predicate, a decision table (rules with a hit policy), or a decision tree (branch/leaf nodes) — then evaluate them against an input Map. Exposed as the single `Decision` namespace.

conventions.import: import "./decision.aql"  — binds the `Decision` namespace. Imports no aql:* dependencies; callers need nothing else.
conventions.call: forward form, verb first, then its arguments: `Decision.verb arg1 arg2`. Wrap a call in parens, or end it, when a bare value would otherwise follow the verb and get swallowed: `(Decision.decide table {age:25})`.
conventions.evaluator_arg_order: evaluators take the MODEL first, the input second: `Decision.eval-table table input`, `Decision.decide model input`, `Decision.eval-cond cond input`. (In stack form the model sits on TOP of the input: `input table Decision.eval-table`.) apply-op is `Decision.apply-op rhs op lhs` and computes `lhs op rhs`.
conventions.construct: Records are plain `refine Record` values — build them with a builder OR write them as Map literals; the evaluators only read fields. Node ids (make-branch/make-leaf/make-tree) are Atoms — quote bare names with /q (e.g. root/q).
conventions.ops: binary Comparable ops (used in conditions and apply-op): eq, neq, lt, lte, gt, gte. Unary ops: is_true, is_false, is_null, is_not_null — reachable ONLY via the direct two-arg `Decision.apply-op rhs op`, NOT inside a condition/table/tree (eval-cond always supplies a value, so a unary op there raises).
conventions.hit_policies: for tables: "first" (default — first matching rule's then), "unique" (the single match; multiple-matches/no-match errors), "collect" (a List of every matching rule's then), "priority" (the matching rule with the highest `priority` field, default 0).
conventions.error_results_not_exceptions: evaluators never throw on a miss; they return a Map {ok:false error:...} with error one of: "no-match", "multiple-matches", "unknown-model-kind", "no-branch-match", "node-not-found", "unknown-node-kind", "max-depth-exceeded". A hit is your bare then/leaf value (no ok/error fields); inspect result.error to tell a miss from a hit.
conventions.missing_field_gotcha: an ordering op (lt/lte/gt/gte) on a MISSING field RAISES `not_comparable` — a missing field is None, not Comparable, so the op raises rather than returning false. eq/neq return false for a missing field; guarantee the field is present, or compare it only with eq/neq. The unary is_* ops cannot gate this — they are not usable inside conditions.
conventions.import_resolution: relative to the working directory the script is run from, not the importing file
conventions.requires: needs aql >= 61856202 — uses surface/exposes, generics, refine Record, and fnsig. No aql:* deps.

Comparable.note: the cmp contract {cmp: (fnsig [[Self Self] [Integer]])}; the scalar builtins Integer/Float/String/Boolean/Atom expose it. Ordering ops (lt/lte/gt/gte) require Comparable operands.

Rule.note: a when->then pairing; R is the result type, defaults to Any.

DTable.kind: refine Record (generic in R, default Any)
DTable.note: a decision table; hit-policy defaults to "first".

BranchNode.note: an interior tree node; branches = [{when:... next:...} ...].

LeafNode.note: a terminal tree node; R is the result type.

DTree.kind: refine Record (generic in R, default Any)
DTree.note: a decision tree; root = start node id.

cond.note: field is an Atom (age/q); op a String (see ops). A single field/op/value condition.

all-of.note: every child condition/predicate must hold. Builds {kind:"group" op:"all" children:...}.

any-of.note: at least one child must hold. Builds {kind:"group" op:"any" children:...}.

not-of.note: negate one condition. Builds {kind:"group" op:"not" children:...}.

make-rule.note: pair a `when` (cond/pred Map) with a `then` result. `then` MUST be a Map.

make-table.note: a list of rules; hit policy defaults to "first".

with-policy.note: copy `table` with a new hit policy ("first"/"unique"/"collect"/"priority").

make-branch.note: id is an Atom (quote with /q); branches = [{when:... next:...} ...].

make-leaf.note: id is an Atom (quote with /q); result is any value.

make-tree.note: root = the start node id (Atom, quote with /q); nodes = node list.

apply-op.note: the primitive compare, computing `lhs op rhs`. Ordering ops (lt/lte/gt/gte) need Comparable operands; a non-Comparable operand raises not_comparable.

eval-cond.note: reads input.(cond.field) and applies cond.op against cond.value. An ordering op on a missing field raises not_comparable.

eval-pred.note: evaluates an all/any/not group (or a bare condition) against input.

eval-table.note: runs the table under its hit policy. Pass the TABLE (make-table rules), not the raw rules list. collect returns a List.

eval-tree.note: walks branches to a leaf result.

decide.note: dispatches on model.kind ("table" or "tree"). Unknown kind => {ok:false error:"unknown-model-kind"}.
